title: Start here
lede: You have been made a co-course director. Here is what you own, what OME does, and what to do this week.

blocks.text: ExamSoft is where JABSOM writes exam questions, assembles them into an assessment, delivers it on student iPads, and reports on performance. You will spend nearly all your time in two places: the **question bank**, and the **assessment** you build from it. Writing a question does not put it on an exam. Those are separate steps.

blocks.caption: Who does what
rows: Preview the assessment on a real iPad
Build the assessment, usually from last year's
Proof it and send corrections back to you
Print two hard copies as a backup
Build the proctor PowerPoint and post the exam

blocks.title: Your draft is due 7 business days before the exam
blocks.text: Every other date is scheduled backwards from that one. If you remember nothing else on this page, remember this.
Do these three things this week

items.t: Check that you can sign in
items.d: Go to [the portal](https://ei.examsoft.com/GKWeb/login/hawaiimed). Institution ID is `hawaiimed`. It uses your UH login, so there is no separate ExamSoft password. If it refuses you, see [Account and sign-in](docs/#account).

My Preferences, Question Creation tab, two font fields, then Save. Do it before you write anything or you will be reformatting later. Steps and a screenshot are in [Set your preferences first](docs/#preferences).

items.t: Open last year's exam for your course
items.d: You will almost certainly build this year's version from it rather than starting fresh. See [Building an assessment](docs/#building).

items.detail: Questions written, ordered, categorized, attached. This is the handoff.
Preview on iPad, corrections back to you, re-preview, print backups, build proctor materials.
The download window opens so students can pull the exam onto their iPads.
Nobody can open the exam before this, even with the file downloaded.
The assessment overview shows how the class did.

blocks.title: Three things that surprise new course directors
blocks.text: Every question needs at least one category tag, or it disappears from reporting. Drag and Drop does not score the order answers are dragged in. And once the exam is posted and one student has downloaded it, the questions lock.
Everything above is the short version. The reference covers each area in full, with the vendor's Legacy articles linked from every section.
